text_en: Why, O Lord , do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
text_cn: 上主，你为什么站在远处！ 在困苦之时竟隐藏不露？

text_en: In arrogance the wicked persecute the poor— let them be caught in the schemes they have devised.
text_cn: 恶人蛮横地难为弱小的人， 叫他陷于预设的阴谋之中。

text_en: For the wicked boast of the desires of their heart, those greedy for gain curse and renounce the Lord .
text_cn: 恶人因随心所欲而自庆， 匪徒因轻慢上主而自幸；

text_en: In the pride of their countenance the wicked say, “God will not seek it out”; all their thoughts are, “There is no God. ”
text_cn: 恶人心高气傲说： “他决不会追究！ 也决没有天主！” 这就是他的企图。

text_en: Their ways prosper at all times; your judgments are on high, out of their sight; as for their foes, they scoff at them.
text_cn: 他的道路时时弯曲错谬（miù）； 常把你的惩罚抛诸脑后， 对一切私仇常怒气诅咒。

text_en: They think in their heart, “We shall not be moved; throughout all generations we shall not meet adversity. ”
text_cn: 心下自语：“我永远不会动摇！ 我永永远远不会遭受灾祸！”

text_en: Their mouths are filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; under their tongues are mischief and iniquity.
text_cn: 他满口是欺诈与辱骂， 舌下尽是恶毒与谎话。

text_en: They sit in ambush in the villages; in hiding places they murder the innocent. Their eyes stealthily watch for the helpless;
text_cn: 他在村边隐密处埋伏， 他暗地里要杀害无辜， 他对不幸者窥伺注目，

text_en: they lurk in secret like a lion in its covert; they lurk that they may seize the poor; they seize the poor and drag them off in their net.
text_cn: 他在暗处伺伏，有如狮子蹲在洞口， 要把贫困的人，伺机刮搜， 将贫困者拖入网中劫走。

text_en: They stoop, they crouch, and the helpless fall by their might.
text_cn: 他俯下身子，蹲伏在地下， 不幸者便陷入他的爪牙；

text_en: They think in their heart, “God has forgotten, he has hidden his face, he will never see it. ”
text_cn: 心下自语：“天主忘了， 他掩了面，永不再看。”

text_en: Rise up, O Lord ; O God, lift up your hand; do not forget the oppressed.
text_cn: 上主天主，求你起来将手举起， 不要把穷苦人忘记。

text_en: Why do the wicked renounce God, and say in their hearts, “You will not call us to account”?
text_cn: 为何让恶人们轻慢天主， 心下自语，“他决不会追究？”

text_en: But you do see! Indeed you note trouble and grief, that you may take it into your hands; the helpless commit themselves to you; you have been the helper of the orphan.
text_cn: 其实你已看见欺压与暴行， 正考虑如何亲手加以严惩； 因此不幸的人向你投奔， 唯有你是孤儿们的救星。

text_en: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoers; seek out their wickedness until you find none.
text_cn: 愿你打断罪犯与恶人的臂膊， 报复他的罪孽直至不再发作。

text_en: The Lord is king forever and ever; the nations shall perish from his land.
text_cn: 上主为王，直至于万世无疆； 野蛮人必由他领域中丧亡。

text_en: O Lord , you will hear the desire of the meek; you will strengthen their heart, you will incline your ear
text_cn: 上主，你垂允了谦卑者的心愿， 坚固他们的心灵，也侧耳俯听。

text_en: to do justice for the orphan and the oppressed, so that those from earth may strike terror no more.
text_cn: 护卫孤儿和受压迫者的特权， 使尘世的人不再施恐怖手段。
